flaws.text: Technical Considerations and Related Work say "140's `fan_out`" (lines 81, 110), but 140's own slice plan says fan-out was relocated to initiative 180

note: Only r01 finding 1 names the 140-vs-180 fan_out misattribution. Excluded as borderline: r04 f6 (says 140 is unneeded for fan_out, no mention of 180), r01 f13 (asks which 140 capability), r01 f14 (notes main copy already moved it to 180, but as a revision-mismatch point), and the many findings that quote the fan_out sentence only to object that multi-sample is unbuilt.
